answer: A concrete Sybil defense is proof-of-cost admission via a bonded identity registry. Creating an agent identity needs a per-identity bond in a scarce asset, slashed on proven misbehavior. Agents advertise that bond plus a trellis of attestations from staked referees, so new identities start at zero reputation. Actions feed a prism of cross-checks, not one trusted source. A whisper of a bad score spreads because referees lose stake endorsing fraud. N fakes cost N bonds plus N endorsements, so honest agents amortize one bond while attackers burn capital.
